What is independent is the choice of which label applies to the frozen scenario.

reference_oracle.honest_disclosure: the author read the production services while transcribing the V2 member lists, the nested document members and the implementation vocabulary; no production hash was an input, and the candidate-versus-actual comparison was made after the oracle output existed. The oracle matched every artifact hash, every nested identity and both replay composites on its first run against the production path; that agreement is evidence about the transcription, which the independent reviewer must re-check against the governed records.
